name: starfield-hdr
prompt: Starfield flying toward the camera. Make the brightest stars overbright (values above 1) so a glow effect can pick them up later.

provenance.via: claude --print with the in-app agent instructions (no Powermove MCP tools)

summary: I wrote a starfield shader layer that flies toward the camera through 6 looping depth layers. Stars speed up and stretch outward as they approach, and a random 8% of stars are "hot" and multiplied by uHotGain = 4.0, so their values go well above 1.0 for a glow effect to pick up. I couldn't compile or render it because no Powermove tools were attached to this run. The output isn't clamped, but the values above 1 only survive if the render target stores float/HDR values. The other controls are uSpeed, uDensity, uHotRatio, uStreak, uTint, uHotTint and uBg.
